message: My laptop won't turn on after the latest Windows update. I've tried holding the power button for 30 seconds but nothing happens. I have a client presentation in 2 hours!
I can't access the shared drive. It keeps saying 'access denied'. I was able to access it yesterday. My colleague sitting next to me can still access it fine.
I received a suspicious email from what looks like our CEO asking me to wire $50,000 to a new vendor. The email address looks slightly different from the real one. Should I report this?
The internet keeps dropping every 10 minutes across the entire 3rd floor. Multiple people are affected and we can't join video calls. This started after maintenance last night.
Outlook stopped syncing this morning. I haven't received any emails since 8 AM. I've tried restarting Outlook and clearing the cache but it didn't help. I'm expecting an important contract today.
My computer has become extremely slow since IT installed the new antivirus software yesterday. Applications take 2-3 minutes to open and it freezes constantly. I can barely work.
